title: A file that opens and holds too few bytes for an `IHDR`
why: **Strictly a fetch/open/read failure** is what `artifact-unreadable` covers. A file that *opens* and is merely truncated is not that: the preflight gets its hands on the bytes and finds too few of them. The line is where the failure occurs, not how little data there turned out to be — otherwise the same bytes are describable by both tokens and two engines pick differently.
